notes: CB10 DRAFT, not committed to queue/jobs: needs the code-against-design freeze check (science-reviewer) first. Rules file seals/cb10_rules.json (rules_sha256 2db70d9a...). --data-dumps-cap-gb 40 (ops convention; design text says 14). Not a queue job: two cron lines (0 16 and 0 17 UTC; acts only at 12:00 America/New_York) committed to scripts/oracle/crontab.txt and deployed only if D1 advanced.
